videos.description: 🔥 The Trump-Putin summit in Alaska is already one of the most talked-about global events of 2025. Today, world leaders met face-to-face at the Alaska Summit 2025, with everyone watching closely—discussing Ukraine, sanctions, and global security. But the internet had other plans… Enter the legendary meme Wide Putin Walking, where Putin famously walks down the red carpet to iconic music. Now the meme comes to life in real life: red carpet, cameras from around the world, and moments that look made for TikTok and YouTube Shorts. People are already joking about Wide Putin Alaska Edition and even creating Wide Trump remixes, blending politics with internet culture. 📌 This video is the perfect mix of history and memes: watch how diplomacy turns into a viral trend.
